title: Compressed Slime Block
description:
You make compressed slime blocks by right clicking vanilla slime blocks with a shovel; this costs the shovel 1 durability. Any entity that comes in contact with one gets bounced upwards. You can right click it 2 more times to compress it further, increasing its bounciness (each step costs 1 durability too). Compressed slime blocks cannot be crafted, and breaking one drops a plain slime block.

Each right click compresses the block by one step.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Right click a slime block with a shovel
